scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:frontend
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.json --pretty false
scripts.format:check: prettier --check README.md package.json frontend/src scripts docs hardhat.config.ts vite.config.ts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.deploy:local: npm run compile && hardhat run --no-compile scripts/deploy-local.ts --network localhost
scripts.deploy:sepolia: npm run compile && hardhat run --no-compile scripts/deploy-sepolia.ts --network sepolia
scripts.demo: npm run compile && hardhat run --no-compile scripts/demo.ts --network localhost
